description: Finds a literal string (no regular expressions) in the text files of a public GitHub repository at a commit sha or an npm package version, and returns the matches with path, line number, line text and the file's git blob id. A hit is a proven match in the exact bytes named. Counts of files scanned, binary files (a NUL byte or invalid UTF-8; never searched as text) and files over the per-file memory bound are reported, so nothing is silently left out. Pages with offset/limit: at most 1000 matches and about 1 MB per page (truncated:true when the byte bound ended a page); next_offset names the next page. Every answer, an error included, carries a pauhu-library-receipt/2 in structuredContent.receipt and as a trailing "receipt: {...}" text line; library_verify checks a receipt.

extensions.description: Only files ending in one of these, e.g. [".ts", ".js"]

package.description: npm package name, e.g. source-map-js or @scope/name. Give this or repo.

path.description: Only files under this directory prefix

ref.description: Branch, tag or 40-hex commit sha (default HEAD). It is resolved to a commit sha first; the read is at that sha.

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, e.g. nodejs/node. Give this or package.

version.description: npm version or dist-tag (default latest); the tarball is checked against the registry's sha512 integrity.

name: code_grep
title: Search source text at an exact identity
